up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document identified by CHEMBL4303122. For each compound, provide the following information: compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), compound preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Link the document to its compounds via the compound_records table, which stores doc_id and molregno. Use only the document ChEMBL ID as filter; do not add any other constraints on activity data or assay types.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4303122';
